<!-- Release: v0.18.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- App-wide glass controls and fluid control-to-panel transitions, including scoped search, creation menus, selectors and nested dialogs
- Continuous mini-player expansion with softer artwork edges, a later handle reveal and neutral Queue frosting
- Interactive artwork swipes with blended cover bridges; buttons and autoplay retain the selected stationary transition
- Durable queue visit history, prepared playback transitions, anchored pinch layouts and more responsive browsing
- Compact typography, larger pink-accented tabs, adjustable interface gray and consistent preference controls

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/75 - Pinch between list and gallery sizes while retaining position
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/82 - Swipe artwork to move through the queue
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/83 - Persistent playback journey and shuffle history
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/85 - Search pills morph into panels and restore list spacing
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/86 - Shared glass controls, overlays and motion throughout the app
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/88 - Immediate navigation/filter feedback and cached browsing
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/89 - Typography, icons, accent color and persistent gray control
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/90 - Unified player expansion, softened cover edges and late handle reveal
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/91 - Remove the Queue drawer’s blue tint

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.18.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. Install over the existing development build to retain your data.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
